# Compare

Selects parts of your scene by comparing two values, such as height and a ground level.

`lfs.compare` · Utilities

## How to use

Connect height to A and your ground level to B, then choose Less Than.  
Epsilon only affects Equal and Not Equal.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | `A` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | First number in the units of your calculation. 0 is the default. |
| B | `B` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Second number in the units of your calculation. 0 is the default. |
| Epsilon | `Epsilon` | lfs.float | 0.001 | min 0; step 0.001; accepts per-element values | Tolerance for Equal and Not Equal, in the same units as A and B. 0 means exact; the default is 0.001. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Result | `Result` | lfs.bool | — | — | On for selected elements, off for unselected elements. Connect to a Selection or Boolean input. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Operation | `operation` | enum | equal | less_than; less_equal; greater_than; greater_equal; equal; not_equal | Comparison to make. Equal is the default; choose Less Than or Greater Than to select either side of B. |
